[[Image:Broenshoej Boldklub hjemme mod Fremad Amager.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Brønshøj Boldklub – Fremad Amager, 2005.]]
'''Brønshøj Boldklub''', commonly referred to as '''Brønshøj BK''', is a Danish [[association football|football]] club based in the [[Brønshøj]] district of [[Copenhagen]]. Founded on 15 May 1919, the club plays its home matches at [[Tingbjerg Idrætspark]] and currently competes in the [[Danish 3rd Division]], the fourth tier of [[Danish football league system|Danish football]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bronshojboldklub.dk/Klubben/Historie |title=Historie |website=bronshojboldklub.dk |language=da}}</ref>

The club reached its highest-ever [[Danish 1st Division|1st Division]] finish of fifth place in 1984 under manager [[Ebbe Skovdahl]], and has been represented on the [[Denmark national football team|Denmark national team]] by eleven players, most notably [[Per Røntved]] and [[Kent Nielsen]]. [[Finn Laudrup]], father of [[Michael Laudrup|Michael]] and [[Brian Laudrup]], also came through the club. Brønshøj has never operated as a fully professional club and has historically maintained a strong identity as a working-class neighbourhood club rooted in its local community."}}
